output_text: Always use functional components. All new code must be in TypeScript. Prefer `StyleSheet`. Use Expo Router’s file-based routing in `app/`; use `useLocalSearchParams()` for route params. ❌ BAD: Manual stack/tab navigator setup in a single file for all routes. Always create new objects/arrays when updating state; never mutate state directly. Carefully manage `useEffect` dependency arrays to avoid unnecessary re-renders or infinite loops. Use `.env`/`EXPO_PUBLIC_` client variables; `process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL`. ❌ BAD: `API_KEY=mysecret` in `.env` and `process.env.
